column2: [title19][sentence]\nThis must be where the guards monitor\nsecurity operations.

[title30][sentence]
Peering into the depths of the coffee mug,
you notice what appears to be a small
bacteria colony declaring independence from
it's larger neighbor.

[title26][sentence]
The doughnut is no longer edible.  It has
been sitting here for . . . well, it's probably too 
old to be carbon dated.  The glaze has
flowed down onto the newspaper forming
a permanent bond.

[title30][sentence]
Hoping to find something interesting you take
a quick look at the magazine.  It does not resemble
the "Gal" magazine you used to read--everyone
is in this issue is dressed.

[title27][sentence]
These little footballs remind you of boarding
school.  The only field goal you scored
in your entire life was with one of these.

[title32][sentence]
You are not sure how old this newspaper is.  Through
the doughnut stains and coffee spillage
you are able to make out the headline, which
reads: "War Of The Sexes - Women Wind Up On
Top."

[title25][sentence]
The clipboard has a pencil and a strange
note on it.  From the illegibility of the
handwriting you assume the author was
engaged in medical practice.

[title25][sentence]
In front of you are two monitors used by the
guards for security purposes.  The desk they
sit at is cluttered with junk.

[title29][sentence]
The contents of the mug have already
rendered it incapable of being resanitized.
You decide that there are more interesting
ways to catch exotic diseases.
[title25][sentence]\nThere isn't any blank paper left to\ndoodle on, so you decide to leave it.

[title26][sentence]
The doughnut may yet evolve into
the cure for something, but currently
it holds no value.
[title20][sentence]\nYou'd just lose it.  Leave it here.
[title19][sentence]\nThere are no naked pictures in it,\nso it is of no use to you.

[title22][sentence]
The newspaper is stuck to the desk
by the adhesive doughnut glaze.
[title12][sentence]\nYou see a rock wall.

[title29][sentence]
The keypad has twelve keys on it.
The numerals zero through nine are
present, as well as 'smile' and 'frown'
keys.

[title29][sentence]
This is entry device is about
as complicated as a pocket
calculator.  Take your time;
you'll get it eventually.
[title25][sentence]\nIt's a key.  Hint: It's about the same\nsize as the tip of a human finger.

[title17][sentence]
You are standing in an
alien teleportation device.

[title26][sentence]
Close examination reveals that the screen
has been disabled by a small piece of
rock, which appears to have transferred
an inordinate amount of kinetic energy to the
picture tube.

[title25][sentence]
As you examine the damage you are 
glad that you were on the good side
of that large sauropod fellow.

[title25][sentence]
You are amazed by the strength of the
sauropod and feel sorry for any dogs 
in the area.
[title27][sentence]\nThis guard has apparently seen better days.

[title33][sentence]
This guard has probably looked better.  You 
gather the credit chip in her hand was used in
an attempt to buy her safety from your large
friend.  Apparently, the offer was refused.

[title33][sentence]
This equipment has been pretty well
destroyed.  Even if you could repair
it you wouldn't know how to use it.
You would be wise to consider it "scrap".
[title19][sentence]\nThe desk, along with everything around\nit, has been demolished.

[title20][sentence]
The machine serves as this poor
guard's head rest.  In its current condition,
it is capable of little else.
[title20][sentence]\nThis gadget looks familiar to you.
[title27][sentence]\nIt's blinking!  That means it probably works.\nToo bad it's operation is a complete mystery to you.
[title20][sentence]\nThrough the door is the security area\nyou just came from.

[title26][sentence]
The room has been devastated, with things
thrown and smashed everywhere.
The place certainly has changed since you
were here last.  What a mess!

[title20][sentence]
The pole obviously serves some important
structural purpose, the exact nature of which
is beyond your architectural expertise.
[title25][sentence]\nWell, don't just stand there.\nGo around it.

[title24][sentence]
The large pipes must carry something
somewhere.  None of them have been
damaged.

[title21][sentence]
The broken beam must have helped
support part of the ceiling.  You don't
want to be standing here if it
gives way.
[title18][sentence]\nTo the north you see another\nroom through the doorway.
[title19][sentence]\nThe corridor leads south toward a four-way\nintersection.

[title25][sentence]
Your friend has obviously been here.
The hallway is in sad shape.  There
are no guards here, living or otherwise.

[title25][sentence]
The floor is covered with debris
from the walls, including a couple
large chunks of rock.
[title20][sentence]\nThe ceiling is covered with pipes.

[title26][sentence]
The walls here were obviously carved
from the native rock.  They would be
interesting only to a geologist.

[title33][sentence]
These controls run the hallway sensor arrays,
which detect such things as temperature, humidity,
and shoe and blouse clashes.

[title25][sentence]
This must be a busy intersection.  The
signal is not currently operating, so you
assume this is an off-peak hour.

[title27][sentence]
These catwalks look like they
might be used for maintenance
purposes.  They are well out
of your reach.

[title21][sentence]
You don't remember this duct being
connected to the air shafts you crawled
through.  It must be a return vent.

[title24][sentence]
You are standing at the intersection
of two hallways.  You notice a dead
guard sitting under a devastated wall.

[title26][sentence]
This corridor to the north appears
to have suffered the same fate as
this corridor.

[title25][sentence]
The corridor to the south has not
been significantly damaged.  You
see an odd device down that way.
[title25][sentence]\nThe corridor to the detention area has\nbeen severely damaged by your friend.

[title30][sentence]
The corridor to the west has not been
damaged.  Your friend must not have
gone that way.

[title25][sentence]
Something hit the walls here pretty
hard.  There are piles of debris
everywhere.

[title29][sentence]
This guard has not had a fun day.
Her rifle has been broken in half,
her legs look broken, and worst
of all, her hair is messed up.

[title21][sentence]
This is the air vent you jimmied, then escaped
through.  You don't need to worry about it any more
now that the cell block has been demolished.
[title22][sentence]\nYou don't need to do that.  You now\nhave free run of the detention area.
[title27][sentence]\nLooking again at this awful bed you are\nglad you aren't going to have to sleep in it.

[title33][sentence]
Egad!  Look at all the stringy hair
clumped together in the drain.  It's 
just like your sink, except that there
isn't anything crawling around in it.

[title26][sentence]
Noticing that the seat is down you
quickly conclude that the last prisoner
must have been female.  You are
momentarily stunned by your own
brilliance.

[title25][sentence]
Your cell has changed a bit since
you were last here.  You pal seems
to have redecorated a bit.

[title25][sentence]
The back wall of this cell was obviously
carved from solid rock.  The other walls
are made of a strong ferrous metal.

[title26][sentence]
Possibly the only thing in the room brighter
than yourself, the light bathes the room in
a sodium-orange glow.
[title17][sentence]\nEven the floor wasn't safe from\nthat beast's rampage.
[title17][sentence]\nThere are bits of wall and guard all\nover the place.

[title29][sentence]
Talk about useless stuff.  You
briefly consider taking some of
the debris, then come to your
senses and decide to move on.

[title29][sentence]
The corridor walls have suffered
some damage at the hands of your
large friend.  There are occasional
pieces of guard splattered against
the walls to the west of you.

[title27][sentence]
This leads to the medical examination
room.  There doesn't appear to be
anyone in there.

[title30][sentence]
Down the corridor you see much of the
same kind of damage you see here.  There
are remnants of guards all over the place.
[title26][sentence]\nYou don't see anyone in that direction,\nbut the corridor looks badly damaged.
[title22][sentence]\nThere's no one there.  The corridor\nhas been mostly demolished.
[title22][sentence]\nYou can't imagine your friend being\nable to lie down on this tiny thing.

[title25][sentence]
The sink is relatively clean except
for some crusty dried-up monster 
saliva.

[title27][sentence]
It's empty.  Maybe your friend
got thirsty?  You decide not to be
judgmental as you remember
some of the things you've poured
down your throat.
[title16][sentence]\nThis cell looks remarkably like\nthe one you were in.

[title25][sentence]
The corridor here is as devastated
as everything else that came
between your friend and the
teleporter he used to escape.

[title27][sentence]
The latch on this air vent hasn't
corroded at all.  This would be
difficult to open from the
other side.  Fortunately you
don't need to worry about crawling
around in air ducts any more.

[title30][sentence]
As you look at the heavily stained walls
you are almost religiously thankful that
the large fellow was your friend.  There
are two distinct shades of stain in the cell.
You suppose that the monster and his last
meal are both represented here.
[title19][sentence]\nThis bed looks like it has been used for\na dining table.

[title25][sentence]
There are many unrecognizable chunks
in the sink.  For the sake of your stomach
you decide to stare elsewhere.

[title25][sentence]
Clean!  This monster that lived here
must have had some other way of
dealing with waste.

[title19][sentence]
Wow!  Your friend sure lived up to his
promise.  The beast that inhabited this
cell looks like it had an unexpected
encounter with a wood chipper.
There are pieces of monster all over the
place.  You notice some sort of card on
the floor amidst the stains.

[title20][sentence]
Wow!  Your friend sure lived up to his
promise.  The beast that inhabited this
cell looks like it had an unexpected
encounter with a wood chipper.
There are pieces of monster all over the
place.
[title22][sentence]\nThe corridor to the east is trashed.\nYou don't see anyone moving.

[title27][sentence]
You don't see any guards down that
way at the moment.  The corridor
itself is in pretty bad shape.

[title26][sentence]
This limb looks humanoid, but you
can't be sure.  What's the difference
anyway?  Parts is parts.
[title25][sentence]\nYou have no need for this\ndisgusting limb.

[title26][sentence]
You cringe as you fish the card
out of the gooey mound of bloody
monster flesh.

[title25][sentence]
This must have been worn by the
poor guard this beast was
snacking on.

[title25][sentence]
There are stains everywhere.  It appears
Your large friend tore this beast into numerous little
chunks and sprayed them all over the place.
Partially imbedded in one of the mounds
on the floor is a small laminated card.

[title26][sentence]
There are stains everywhere.  It appears
Bud tore this beast into numerous little
chunks, and sprayed him all over the place.
[title26][sentence]\nThis was obviously part of the wall before\nyour friend came through here.
[title19][sentence]\nYou quickly decide not to carry\naround construction supplies.
[title27][sentence]\nYour friend must have been in a destructive\nmood to have torn the floor up like that.

[title25][sentence]
The corridor here is in sad shape.
Pieces have been ripped from the walls;
parts of the floor have been torn up.  Your
friend definitely has a violent streak.

[title25][sentence]
The floor is covered with red stains
and miscellaneous chunks of monster.
Partially imbedded in one little puddle
is some sort of laminated card.

[title25][sentence]
The floor is covered with red stains
and various-sized chunks of monster.
[title25][sentence]\nThe corridor to the west has been torn to pieces.\nThere are no guards in sight.

[title25][sentence]
The corridor to the east is in even worse
shape than this one.  You don't see
any movement down that way.
[title21][sentence]\nThis bed is clean.  It looks unused.
[title17][sentence]\nThe sink is clean and empty.

[title21][sentence]
You have sudden flashbacks of
many religious experiences in close
proximity to this type of plumbing
hardware.  As reality summons you
back you note only that the toilet
is clean.
[title20][sentence]\nThe cell is empty and the damage\nsurrounding it is minimal.

[title22][sentence]
The air vent is closed and the
latch is in good shape.  Fortunately
you won't be needing to crawl around
in there any more.
[title21][sentence]\nThe corridor has been damaged by the\npassage of a certain large and angry sauropod.

[title26][sentence]
The damage to the walls here is
extensive.  It's going to take a lot
of work to repair this hallway.

[title25][sentence]
On the desk you see a pair of monitors,
some papers, and the stale remains
of a doughnut.  The system the monitors
were hooked up to has stopped working.

[title26][sentence]
The rear wall is carved out of native rock, much
like the cell you just escaped from.  The walls
in the hallway show signs of damage from
the violent passage of your large friend.

[title30][sentence]
The thought that the same interior decorator
who chose 'early Mesozoic igneous' decor
for the back wall chose 'art deco' for these
lighting fixtures.  Falling objects pretty well
destroyed these fixtures.
[title19][sentence]\nThe panels of white lights keep this room\nextremely well lit.
[title22][sentence]\nYou don't have any need for forty feet of\nfluorescent light fixtures.

[title26][sentence]
The little bulb dangling from a wire
in the middle of the room is dwarfed
by the light panels on either side.  This
must have been left here by the original
construction crew.
[title21][sentence]\nAttempting to steal this little light bulb\nwould accomplish little.

[title32][sentence]
Your pal pretty much killed everything that
inhabited the immediate area.  You don't need
to worry about any guards out there.
[title16][sentence]\nYou don't see any signs of life in that direction.

[title22][sentence]
The equipment in this room has been rendered
useless.  Your large friend did quite a good
job of trashing the place.

[title26][sentence]
You pretty much destroyed the latch when
you kicked the grate open.  You shouldn't
have any trouble getting it open again.  Of
course the absence of any living guards
probably  means you don't need to crawl
around in air ducts any more.
[title26][sentence]\nYou see some strange machinery in there.\nThat must be some kind of equipment room.
[title26][sentence]\nConsidering what it did to you earlier, that\nmust be the infamous gender bender!
[title20][sentence]\nSince the latch is already broken,\nyou gently push open the grate.

[title33][sentence]
Your first kick serves only to
annoy your already-sore ankle.
Fortunately, your second kick destroys
the latch and the grate swings open.
[title19][sentence]\nThis was your cell for a while.  You do not\nmiss it at all.

[title27][sentence]
When you climbed in here you let
the air vent shut behind you, and the
latch closed again.  You give it a few
kicks, but the latch is too strong.

[title24][sentence]
This is your friend's cell.  He doesn't
look very happy sitting there.  You get the
distinct feeling he would be much happier
if he were ripping guards up and destroying
things.
[title17][sentence]\nThis was your friend's cell before\nyou released him.

[title25][sentence]
You give the grate a couple good kicks,
but the latch on the other side is just
too strong.  You decide that you aren't
terribly interested in climbing into this
cell anyway.

[title32][sentence]
That horrible monster is in there
busily eating some unfortunate guard.
The sounds he is making in the process
are turning your stomach.

[title25][sentence]
There are pieces of guard and monster
scattered all over the cell.  Something
shiny on the floor catches your eye, but
you can't make it out from here.

[title25][sentence]
There are pieces of guard and monster
scattered all over the cell.  It's truly
disgusting.

[title26][sentence]
Briefly considering the fate
of the guard in that cell you decide
that you like having something
metallic between you and that
creature.

[title29][sentence]
You give the grate a couple kicks
and discover that it is stronger than
you are.
[title21][sentence]\nThere is nothing interesting about\nthis cell.  It is completely empty.

[title24][sentence]
You give the grate a couple kicks
but it does not give way.  In
frustration you kick it a few more
times, which serves only to hurt
your ankle.
